recent.text: Tari Eason is up to 25 points and 7 rebounds tonight. Another huge game for him off the bench.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: End of 1st half: Rockets 73, Wizards 54 Thompson 19 pts, 5 rebs, 4 assts Durant 16 pts (5-8 FG) Sengun 9 pts, 4 rebs, 4 assts Spectacular half of offense from the Rockets. They shot 56.5 percent from the floor, 10-20 on 3s, 19 assists and 5 turnovers. Amen Thompson played maybe
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: The #Rockets drop 73 on the Wizards in the first half, lead 73-54. Houston shoots 56.5%/50/84.6. Even w/o Fred VanVleet, just five turnovers. Amen Thompson: 19 points, 5 rebounds, 4 assists, two TOs, 1 stl, 1 block, 7/9 shooting. 3/3 on threes. That'll play!
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Steven Adams is moving around so much better than he was in that San Antonio game in October. Adding his physicality and offensive rebounding is gonna make a such huge difference for this team.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Multiple really nice passes by Steven Adams so far tonight. He's already up to 9 minutes so curious where he finishes.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Amen Thompson came into tonight shooting 2-11 on 3-pointers. He's 3-3 on 3s in the 1st half tonight.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: That's a career high
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Amen Thompson: 3/3 on 3s
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Amen Thompson's doing a great job of getting downhill and making plays in the paint early on. Rockets are also 6-11 on 3s, which should open more driving lanes. Still feel like they can attack Trae Young in the post more than they did in the 1st.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Interesting chess match to watch: Trae Young wants run pick and rolls with Reed Sheppard and Alperen Şengün in the action. #Rockets defended that action by putting 2 on the ball — led to an open corner 3 and a semi-open floater, both from Coulibaly, a career 30.5% shooter
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Nice ball movement by the #Rockets — inverted PNR w KD and Sheppard gets the Wiz in rotation, leads to an open Tari Eason 3. Houston up 27-23 early. Both teams 9/18, Rockets have taken 3 more threes though. KD, Amen w 7p each.
recent.author: Varun Shankar
